newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-N.TVL 145-7 AT TEA CHASING 265 TO BEAT WP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-N.TVL 145-7 AT TEA CHASING 265 TO BEAT WP.

text.p: Northern Transvaal were 145 for seven from 42 overs at tea needing 265 in a minimum of 87 overs to beat Western Province on the fourth and final day of their Supersport Series match at Newlands on Monday.
Scores: Western Province 220 (H.Ackerman 51, J.Commins 81 not out) and 399 (S.Koenig 97, D.Haynes 71, E.Simons 61), Northern Transvaal 355 (R.Richardson 56, R.Pienaar 95) and 145-7.
